title: Free boundary minimal annuli in convex balls
summary: We construct a $4$-parameter family of properly embedded genus-zero surfaces with at most two boundary components in a Riemannian $3$-ball. The construction is a free boundary analog of the canonical $5$-parameter family of surfaces on the $3$-sphere by Marques-Neves in the proof of Willmore conjecture. In the Euclidean unit ball, this family realizes the critical catenoid as a Simon-Smith min-max limit.
